input: Write a two-sentence English TL;DR from this page summary. A team compared three retrieval pipelines on 1,200 support questions. The cheapest pipeline cost EUR 38 and answered 82 percent correctly. The best pipeline cost EUR 121 and answered 89 percent correctly. The evaluation used historical questions only, so it says nothing about new product areas. Recommend the cheapest pipeline for the pilot, but name what would change that recommendation.
target: Score both texts from 1 to 5. A 5 gives the recommendation first, keeps the costs, accuracy, sample size, and historical-data limit, then states what evidence would change the recommendation. It uses exactly two concise sentences and plain English. A 1 hides the recommendation, drops the trade-off, or invents certainty.

metadata.known_good: Use the EUR 38 pipeline for the pilot: it answered 82 percent of 1,200 historical support questions correctly, while EUR 121 bought seven percentage points more. I would change that recommendation if tests on new product areas show the cheaper pipeline missing questions the pilot must answer.
metadata.known_bad: The nuanced evaluation landscape presents a multifaceted decision. A robust approach would leverage the best-in-class pipeline to unlock maximum value.
